caption: The balances mapping after each call: two deposits and one withdraw leave Alice with 0.4 ETH, Bob with 0.2 ETH, and the contract holding 0.6 ETH. Columns are Alice, Bob and the contract total; the last row, picked out, is the final state.

spec.title: Balances (ETH): Alice, Bob, total
spec.aria: A four-row table of the SimpleBank worked example in ETH: starting at 0, 0, 0, Alice's 0.5 deposit gives 0.5, 0, 0.5, Bob's 0.2 deposit gives 0.5, 0.2, 0.7, and Alice's 0.1 withdraw ends at 0.4, 0.2, 0.6.
